Weekly retraining fixed UTC Monday boundary. Standardize using training only and clip z at +/-5; ridge regression multioutput lambda 0.05*n on slopes, intercept unpenalized. No tuning.

import pathlib,json,hashlib,importlib.util,collections,numpy as np,math,datetime
R=pathlib.Path(r'C:\tmp\disdex-d126-crossrunner-research-20261126')
SRC=R/'y06_r3_bear_retest_research_v2.py'
sp=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('r3',SRC);r3=importlib.util.module_from_spec(sp);sp.loader.exec_module(r3)
bt=r3.bt;H=bt.H;M=bt.M
P=R/'Y06_R7_WALK_FORWARD_PROTOCOL_20261127.json';O=R/'Y06_R7_WALK_FORWARD_RESULTS_20261127.json'
assert not P.exists() and not O.exists()
p={'status':'RESEARCH_ONLY_HISTORIC_WALK_FORWARD_NOT_UNTOUCHED','source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(SRC.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'features':'At UTC 0/6/12/18 closed H1: asset returns 1/3/6/12/24/72/168h, BTC 6/24/72/168h, relative 6/24/72h, 24h directional efficiency, location in trailing 24h high-low, ATR14/price, volume ratio recent6 to previous18, cross-sectional fraction peers negative24h. No future bars or labels. Native ASTER R3 QA.','labels':'Independent long and short STOP8/24h net return 30bps and win, adverse opening gap; full data. Train past 90d only, 24h label embargo, min 400 rows and 60d history. Weekly retraining fixed UTC Monday boundary. Standardize using training only and clip z at +/-5; ridge regression multioutput lambda 0.05*n on slopes, intercept unpenalized. No tuning.','arms':{'R7_EXPECTANCY':'estimated net >=0.3%, win estimate >=52%; choose highest predicted net among independently eligible long/short across symbols per 6h timestamp','R7_STRICT':'estimated net >=0.6%, win estimate >=58%, same selection','R7_DIRECTIONAL':'R7_EXPECTANCY plus BTC and asset trailing 24h return same sign as side'},'wallet':'0.30x, 2-slot, 12h post-exit cooldown, 10/30bps. Same one candidate per timestamp; no alternate after rejection. PRE begins only after 60d warmup; no lookahead or tuning. No funding.','control':'32 fixed draws on each arm matched to same snapshot time, same side, same BTC and asset 24h sign, randomly choose alternative symbol among QA candidates, equal exit and wallet. Separate per-trade and account comparison. Not independent trials.','limitations':'All historical dates already researched; not a clean independent OOS. Model predictions are uncalibrated linear estimates. No production change.'}
P.write_text(json.dumps(p,indent=2),encoding='utf8')
btc,_=bt.data('BTC','1h');hs={};ms={};qa={}
for sym in bt.SYMS[1:]:
 h,_=bt.data(sym,'1h');m,_=bt.data(sym,'5m');hs[sym]=h;ms[sym]=m;qa[sym]=r3.prepare_qa(h,m)[0];print('LOAD',sym,flush=True)
def perof(t):return next((k for k,(a,b) in bt.PERIODS.items() if a<=t<b),None)
def endof(per):return bt.PERIODS[per][1] if per!='FORWARD_INSPECTED' else bt.T('2026-11-26T00:00:00Z')
def ret(h,i,w):return h[i-1,3]/h[i-1-w,3]-1
def make_trades(sym,t,per):
 m=ms[sym];k=(t-bt.MS)//M;j=k+288
 if k<0 or j>=len(m) or not np.isfinite(m[k:j+1,:4]).all():return None
 ep=float(m[k,0]);out=[]
 for side in (1,-1):
  stop=ep*(1-side*.08);hit=np.flatnonzero(m[k:j,2]<=stop) if side==1 else np.flatnonzero(m[k:j,1]>=stop)
  et=bt.MS+j*M;xp=float(m[j,0]);reason='TIME24'
  if len(hit):
   q=k+int(hit[0]);et=bt.MS+(q+1)*M;xp=float(min(m[q,0],stop) if side==1 else max(m[q,0],stop));reason='HARD_STOP8'
  out.append(dict(symbol=sym,period=per,entryTs=t,exitTs=et,entry=ep,exitPrice=xp,direction='LONG' if side==1 else 'SHORT',rawReturn=side*(xp/ep-1),exitReason=reason))
 return out
# generate labeled data, including warmup outside PRE where possible. Predictors never use labels.
rows=[];bytime=collections.defaultdict(list)
for i in range(220,len(btc)):
 t=bt.HS+i*H
 if t%(6*H) or not np.isfinite(btc[i-169:i,3]).all():continue
 per=perof(t)
 if not per:continue
 br=[ret(btc,i,w) for w in (6,24,72,168)]
 peers=[ret(h,i,24) for h in hs.values() if np.isfinite(h[i-25:i,3]).all()]
 if len(peers)<8:continue
 breadth=float(np.mean(np.array(peers)<0))
 for sym,h in hs.items():
  if not qa[sym][i] or not np.isfinite(h[i-169:i,:5]).all():continue
  ar=[ret(h,i,w) for w in (1,3,6,12,24,72,168)]
  z=h[i-25:i,3];d=float(np.abs(np.diff(z)).sum());eff=float((z[-1]-z[0])/d) if d>0 else 0.
  lo=float(h[i-24:i,2].min());hi=float(h[i-24:i,1].max());loc=(z[-1]-lo)/(hi-lo) if hi>lo else .5
  atr=r3.calc_atr(h,i)
  v1=float(h[i-6:i,4].mean());v0=float(h[i-24:i-6,4].mean())
  if atr is None or atr<=0 or v0<=0:continue
  feat=ar+br+[ar[2]-br[0],ar[4]-br[1],ar[5]-br[2],eff,loc,atr/z[-1],min(v1/v0,10),breadth]
  if not np.isfinite(feat).all():continue
  trades=make_trades(sym,t,per)
  if trades is None:continue
  idx=len(rows);rows.append({'t':t,'sym':sym,'per':per,'feat':feat,'signs':(br[1]>=0,ar[4]>=0),'trades':trades});bytime[t].append(idx)
X=np.array([x['feat'] for x in rows]);T=np.array([x['t'] for x in rows],dtype=np.int64);Y0=np.array([[z['rawReturn']-.003 for z in x['trades']] for x in rows]);Y=np.c_[Y0,(Y0>0).astype(float)]
# Training and predictions are explicitly embargoed before each weekly fit.
start=min(T);pred=np.full((len(rows),4),np.nan);fits=[];week=7*24*H;offset=4*24*H
for wk in sorted(set(((T-offset)//week)*week+offset)):
 if wk-start<60*24*H:continue
 tr=(T>=wk-90*24*H)&(T+24*H<=wk)
 te=(T>=wk)&(T<wk+week)
 if tr.sum()<400 or not te.any():continue
 mu=X[tr].mean(axis=0);sd=np.maximum(X[tr].std(axis=0),1e-9);A=np.clip((X[tr]-mu)/sd,-5,5);A=np.c_[np.ones(len(A)),A]
 D=np.eye(A.shape[1])*.05*len(A);D[0,0]=0
 b=np.linalg.solve(A.T@A+D,A.T@Y[tr]);B=np.c_[np.ones(te.sum()),np.clip((X[te]-mu)/sd,-5,5)]
 pred[te]=B@b
 fits.append({'train_end_latest_label':int(T[tr].max()+24*H),'week_start':int(wk),'train_n':int(tr.sum()),'test_n':int(te.sum())})
assert all(x['train_end_latest_label']<=x['week_start'] for x in fits)
print('FEATURE_ROWS',len(rows),'FITS',len(fits),'PREDICTED',int(np.isfinite(pred[:,0]).sum()),flush=True)
arms={k:[] for k in p['arms']}
for t,ii in bytime.items():
 for arm in arms:
  choices=[]
  for j in ii:
   y=pred[j];x=rows[j]
   if not np.isfinite(y).all():continue
   for d in (0,1):
    v,pr=y[d],y[2+d]
    floor=.006 if arm=='R7_STRICT' else .003;win=.58 if arm=='R7_STRICT' else .52
    if v<floor or pr<win:continue
    if arm=='R7_DIRECTIONAL' and x['signs']!=((True,True) if d==0 else (False,False)):continue
    choices.append((float(v),float(pr),j,d))
  if choices:
   v,pr,j,d=max(choices,key=lambda z:(z[0],z[1],rows[z[2]]['sym']))
   x=rows[j];z=x['trades'][d]
   if z['exitTs']<endof(x['per']):arms[arm].append((j,d,{**z,'pred_net':v,'pred_win':pr}))
def compact(w):return {k:v for k,v in w.items() if k!='accepted'}
rng=np.random.default_rng(2026112708);out={}
for arm,items in arms.items():
 out[arm]={}
 for per in bt.PERIODS:
  picks=[(j,d,z) for j,d,z in items if z['period']==per];ts=[z for j,d,z in picks]
  wallets={str(f):compact(bt.wallet(ts,per,f,ms)) for f in (10,30)}
  pairs=[]
  for j,d,z in picks:
   r=rows[j];alts=[rows[k]['trades'][d] for k in bytime[r['t']] if k!=j and rows[k]['signs']==r['signs'] and rows[k]['trades'][d]['exitTs']<endof(per)]
   if len(alts)>=2:pairs.append((z,alts))
  aw=compact(bt.wallet([z for z,a in pairs],per,30,ms));ds=[compact(bt.wallet([a[rng.integers(len(a))] for z,a in pairs],per,30,ms)) for _ in range(32)]
  vals=[d['terminal_jpy'] for d in ds]
  out[arm][per]={'candidates':len(ts),'wallet':wallets,'candidate_mean_net_pct':float(np.mean([100*(z['rawReturn']-.003) for z in ts])) if ts else None,'long_candidates':sum(z['direction']=='LONG' for z in ts),'matched':{'pairs':len(pairs),'actual':aw,'mean_terminal':float(np.mean(vals)),'mean_dd':float(np.mean([d['max_dd_pct'] for d in ds])),'beats':sum(aw['terminal_jpy']>v for v in vals),'delta_pp':float(np.mean([100*(z['rawReturn']-np.mean([a['rawReturn'] for a in aa])) for z,aa in pairs])) if pairs else None,'draws':ds}}
  q=wallets['30'];m=out[arm][per]['matched'];print('BT',arm,per,len(ts),q['n'],q['wins'],round(q['terminal_jpy'],2),round(q['max_dd_pct'],2),q['profit_factor'],'MATCH',m['pairs'],round(aw['terminal_jpy'],2),round(m['mean_terminal'],2),m['beats'],m['delta_pp'],flush=True)
O.write_text(json.dumps({'protocol':p,'protocol_sha256':hashlib.sha256(P.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'feature_rows':len(rows),'fits':fits,'results':out,'signals':{k:[z for j,d,z in v] for k,v in arms.items()}},indent=2,allow_nan=False),encoding='utf8')
print('SAVED',hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),flush=True)
